snippet: UniChem is large-scale non-redundant database of pointers between chemical structures and EMBL-EBI chemistry resources. Its purpose is to optimise the efficiency with which structure-based hyperlinks may be built and maintained between chemistry-based resources, and is particularly suitable for creating such links 'on the fly' (by use of REST web services).
